patterns.note: Full-bleed lifestyle photography is consistently used as a background for major category sections and product showcases, with minimal text overlays.
Headings and labels frequently utilize uppercase sans-serif typography, often in a lighter weight, for a clean and sophisticated presentation.
A minimalist palette of white, black, and various shades of grey is accented by a distinctive deep red/burgundy, primarily from the brand logo and subtle UI elements.
The main navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and removing the top announcement bar to become a compact, sticky header.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the overlaid text and elements, creating a sense of depth.
Product listings are presented within horizontal carousels, allowing users to swipe or navigate through multiple items within a specific category.

technique_notes: A fixed header element dynamically reduces its height and removes a top announcement bar upon scrolling, transitioning into a compact sticky navigation.
The hero section employs a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text and calls-to-action, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
Product showcases utilize a horizontal slider component, likely powered by Swiper, enabling users to navigate through multiple items within a category using swipe gestures or navigation controls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, often uppercase sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text) are paired with smaller, clean body text, creating a clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks and sections, while product grids maintain a tighter, more dense arrangement.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, aspirational lifestyle photography as the primary visual element for category navigation and product showcases sets a strong, high-end brand tone. This is combined with a very clean, almost minimalist text overlay, allowing the imagery to dominate and convey the brand's aesthetic.
